rules_edition: Official Game Rules v1.20.0 - Collector's Edition
rules_story_title: Story: Secret Deals in the Tomb
rules_story_flavor: "In a cramped, damp burial crypt of a local magnate at the Wojsławice cemetery, there was an unbearable crowd. A decaying coffin served as a conference table, on which a map of Stary Majdan scribbled with charcoal on a shoebox card was laid out. Werewolves sneezed constantly from dust and mustiness, vampires complained of lack of air, ghosts lost their ectoplasmic fluffiness due to humidity and hung sadly under the ceiling lamenting the lack of LTE coverage, and Bardaks quietly unscrewed brass coffin handles trying to steal the Baron's wallet and his spare silver-plated teeth."
rules_story_para1: The Generals debated at midnight on how to approach the old man, who uses battery acid and expired dynamite in his arsenal instead of holy water. The atmosphere was thick with the stench of wet fur, ancient decay, and competitors' moonshine. The alliance was fragile, but the hatred for Jakub was mutual and immense.
rules_story_para2: As Generals, you must now carry out this massive attack before the sun rises and the moonshine in your warriors' veins stops working.
rules_drama_vampire_desc: A fourth-class aristocrat whose cape remembers the Swedish Deluge. He suffers from chronic anemia, because in Wojsławice even cows have too little hemoglobin. Instead of noble blood, he drinks whatever he manages to squeeze out of expired black pudding.
rules_drama_werewolf_desc: Looks like a wet carpet from the PRL era. His "wolf nature" manifests itself mainly in obsessive scratching behind his ear and panic fear of a thrown slipper. On a full moon, he usually argues with the neighbor's dog on a chain.
rules_drama_ghost_desc: The ghost of a former tractor driver. Instead of ectoplasm, he emits the smell of burnt lignite and cheap cigarettes. He is so un-scary that local mice use him as free air conditioning.
rules_drama_bardak_desc: The patriarch of the clan with skin the color of old bacon. In his sticky beard, he keeps spare gaskets for his moonshine apparatus and half a loaf of bread for a rainy day. His gaze is as cloudy as his best distillate.
rules_drama_jakub_desc: The host and main obstacle. An old moonshiner, exorcist, and monster killer. He does not like guests, especially those who trample on his moonshine herb garden. His axe is as sharp as his wit.
rules_elements_board: Board: A 6x6 grid of regions where the battle takes place.
rules_elements_bands: Undead Hordes: Vampires, Werewolves, Ghosts, and Bardaks fighting for dominance.
rules_elements_sets: Sets (Tactical Assault Units): Single small tactical assault units consisting of members of different bands. For placing such a unit on the board, the generals of the respective bands receive victory points.
rules_elements_jakub: Jakub: A unique pawn that destroys everything in its path.
rules_elements_panel_jakub: Jakub's Panel: Side panel for managing statistics and Jakub Wędrowycz's fury.
rules_elements_panel_reinforcements: Bands Reinforcements Panel: Panel indicating the limit and state of pawns of individual bands on the board.
rules_elements_events: Events: Random effects changing the rules of the game every round.
rules_elements_fig2: Figure 2: Event window with description of effects.
rules_elements_fig3: Figure 3: Second example of an event.
rules_flow_intro: The game lasts 12 rounds. Each round consists of five phases:
rules_flow_geometry_neighbor: Neighborhood: Two sectors neighbor each other if they share a common edge (side) or a common corner. Sectors can have from 3 to 8 neighboring sectors.
rules_flow_geometry_dist: Distance: Distance between sectors is measured in steps. Moving to any neighboring sector — vertically, horizontally, or diagonally — takes exactly 1 step. The distance between two sectors is the smallest number of such steps to get from one to another.
rules_flow_geometry_jakub_dist: Distance from Jakub: Distance measured in steps between the sector where Jakub stands and the target sector where the set is placed.
rules_flow_geometry_caption: Examples of distances. Vampire is in the region with Jakub, which is distance 0. Werewolves are at distance 1, Ghosts at distance 2, Bardaks at distance 3.
rules_flow_hierarchy_desc: Resolves all tie situations in the game. Seniority of bands from highest to lowest:
rules_flow_tie_desc: If two or more players have the same number of points, their order does not change. If there is a tie for the winner, the player leading the band higher in the Band Hierarchy wins.
rules_flow_fury_desc: Jakub's level of anger towards a given band. There is no upper limit. Represented by tokens on the track in Jakub's Panel.
rules_flow_range_desc: Jakub's movement range. The base range is 1. If Jakub's fury towards any band is 10 or greater, the range increases by 1 for each such band.
rules_flow_p1_desc: At the beginning of each round, players draw sets. If the draw pile is empty, the discard pile is reshuffled and becomes the new draw pile. Additionally, Jakub receives 2 random sets and updates his fury for the round based on them.
rules_flow_p2_desc: In the first round, players choose a general (in the order: Player 1, Player 2, Player 3). In subsequent rounds, the player with the lowest number of points chooses first (and if there is a tie, the order does not change).
rules_flow_p3_desc: Players take turns in reverse order of points (lowest score goes first). On their turn, a player must either place a set on the board (paying with pawns) or pass. Passing ends the player's phase for the round. The player receives 2 points for passing (bonus points).
rules_flow_p4_desc: Jakub moves and cleanses the board. This phase is fully automated.
rules_flow_p5_desc: A new event card is drawn and applied. Events can change rules, limits, or spawn pawns. The only exception is the grand finale – in the final round, instead of resolving a new event, the struggles are concluded and the final scoring takes place!
rules_scoring_intro: Victory points are awarded to the Herszt of a band whenever a set containing pawns of that band is placed on the board. The points awarded depend on the distance from Jakub and the presence of other pawns:
rules_scoring_vampire_desc: Points = (4 - distance to Jakub) * VampireCount. At max distance of 5, they yield -1 point per vampire.
rules_scoring_werewolf_desc: 1 base point + 1 point for every 3 werewolves (rounded down) in target + neighboring regions. Additional +1 bonus point if distance to Jakub is 0 or 1.
rules_scoring_ghost_desc: 2 - (distance to closest edge) per ghost. If distance to Jakub is within his range, subtract 1 point from each ghost's value.
rules_scoring_bardak_desc: 1 point per Bardak. If distance to Jakub is 0 or 1, they receive 0 points per Bardak.
rules_scoring_ex1: Example 1: Vampire placed at distance 2. Gets base 1 point, no proximity bonus, no punishment. Total: 1 point.
rules_scoring_ex2: Example 2: Vampire placed at distance 1. Gets base 1 point, proximity bonus +1 point, but punishment -1 point (Jakub anger > 0). Total: 1 point.
rules_scoring_ex3: Example 3: Werewolf placed at distance 1. Gets base 1 point, proximity bonus +1 point, no punishment. Total: 2 points.
rules_scoring_ex4: Example 4: Werewolf placed at distance 1 with pack. Gets base 1 point, proximity bonus +1 point, pack bonus +1 point. Total: 3 points.
rules_scoring_ex5: Example 5: Werewolf placed with large pack (size 6). Pack bonus is +2 points. Total: 4 points.
rules_scoring_ex6: Example 6: Vampire placed at distance 2. Distance is 2, so it gets 4 - 2 = 2 points base, no punishment. Total: 2 points.
rules_jakub_p1_desc: Before moving, Jakub destroys pawns of angry bands in his sector, but only up to the level of his Fury. For each destroyed pawn, the Herszt of that band loses 1 point. After each destroyed pawn, Jakub's fury towards that band drops by 1. The fury towards a given band can never fall below 0.
rules_jakub_p2_desc: If Jakub still has anger and no targets in his sector, he moves towards the highest anger target. Range depends on anger. Ties are resolved via the "Band Hierarchy" cascade.
rules_jakub_magnetism_title: ⚡ Unstoppable Animal Magnetism (You can't stop this)
rules_jakub_magnetism_desc: If there is an absolute tie between sectors after checking all angry bands, pawns from all tied sectors are pulled to Jakub's sector. Jakub does not move.
rules_jakub_witness_desc: These points are awarded for the courage of pawns that survived an encounter with Jakub. They are awarded in two cases: right before Jakub leaves his current region (for surviving pawns of a race with anger = 0 in that region) and at the very end of Jakub's phase (for pawns remaining in his final region). The Herszt of that band receives 1 point per surviving pawn.
rules_jakub_p3_desc: At the very end of Jakub's phase (after his movement), if any anger remains on Jakub's track towards a race, half of that anger (rounded up) is distributed as victory points to the current Herszt of that race. The remaining half stays on Jakub's anger track for the next round.
rules_jakub_ex1: Description 1: Jakub kills a Bardak in his sector. Anger drops by 1.
rules_jakub_ex2: Description 2: Jakub moves to the sector with the most Bardaks. Range is 1.
rules_jakub_ex3: Description 3: Jakub kills all pawns in the sector.
rules_jakub_ex4: Description 4: Cascade resolution. Ghosts are higher than Bardaks. Jakub moves to the Ghost sector.
rules_jakub_ex5: Description 5: Jakub kills 2 Ghosts and a Bardak. Hunt ends. Werewolf survives, gets 1 point.
rules_end_bonus_vampires: Vampires: 2 points for each region containing Vampires.
rules_end_bonus_werewolves: Werewolves: 1 point for each Werewolf pawn on the board.
rules_end_bonus_ghosts: Ghosts: 2 points for each region containing only Ghosts, 1 point if Ghosts are the majority.
rules_end_bonus_bardaks: Bardaks: 1 point for each region where Bardaks are in majority.
rules_end_tie_desc: Any ties are resolved by the Band Hierarchy.
rules_faq_q1: Is this a stupid random game?
rules_faq_a1: Yes! If you don't like it, get lost.
rules_faq_a2: It's not so much a game of gaining points as it is a game of making others lose more than you.
rules_faq_q3: How are ties resolved in different situations?
rules_faq_a3:
• Player Turn Order: If there is a tie in victory points, the relative order of those players remains unchanged.
• Jakub's Target Selection: If there is a tie in fury levels, target selection is resolved hierarchically (cascading). In case of an absolute tie, Unbridled Animal Magnetism decides.
• Determining the Winner: If there is a tie in final scores, the winner is the player who controlled the general of the band that is highest in the Band Hierarchy.
rules_faq_q4: What are the recommended strategies for players?
rules_faq_a4:
• Avoid being the first player: The first player in the round has no choice in which band they will control.
• Snitch on the leader: When possible, snitch to Jakub about the leading player (first player) to weaken them.
• Plan your sets ahead: If you expect to control a specific band in the next round, consider saving sets of that band to maximize your points later.
rules_faq_a5:
In plain English:
• Playing Vampires: place sets with Vampires as close to Jakub as possible.
• Playing Werewolves: place next to other Werewolves, ideally near Jakub.
• Playing Ghosts: place as close to the edges of the board as possible, far from Jakub.
• Playing Bardaks: place as far from Jakub as possible.
• Have sets of other races? Don't place them, just carry them to Jakub, it's a good point strategy.
• When choosing a general: consider how many pawns you have in sets of that race and how much fury Jakub has towards them.
• A general higher in the Band Hierarchy gains more points.
• A general lower in the Band Hierarchy loses more points.
rules_footer_note: These rules form the foundation of the MASAKRA na Starym Majdanie simulator logic.

event.22.title: Corner Clearing
event.22.description: Jakub patrols the outskirts. Every pawn in the 4 corners of the board is eliminated.
event.23.title: Inner Line Breakthrough
event.23.description: Jakub breaks through the inner defenses. Pawns at (1,1), (1,4), (4,1), and (4,4) are eliminated.
event.24.title: Vertical Edge Patrol
event.24.description: Jakub patrols vertical board borders. Pawns on vertical edges (excluding corners) are eliminated.
event.25.title: Horizontal Edge Raid
event.25.description: Jakub raids horizontal board borders. Pawns on horizontal edges (excluding corners) are eliminated.
event.26.title: Center Clearing
event.26.description: Jakub focuses his anger on the heart of the board. All pawns in the 4 central regions are eliminated.
event.27.title: Supply Drop
event.27.description: A mysterious benefactor sends supplies. Each player receives 1 additional set.
event.28.title: Logistics Mastery
event.28.description: Improved supply lines. Each player receives 2 additional sets.
event.29.title: Silent Night
event.30.title: Tactical Relocation
event.30.description: A local skirmish shifts. Move all pawns from (0,0) to (2,2).
event.31.title: Unexpected Panic
event.31.description: Escape from the borders. Move all pawns from (5,5) to (3,3).
event.32.title: Whirlwind
event.32.description: A mystical wind blows. Move all pawns from (0,5) to (1,4).
event.33.title: Charge!
event.33.description: Every pawn on boundary sectors charges 1 sector closer to the center.
event.34.title: Force Field
event.34.description: Pawns within distance 1 of Jakub are pushed away. Pawns at the epicenter do not move. Pawns pushed off the board die (-1 pt to General).
event.35.title: Bardak Cowardice
event.35.description: Lonesome Bardaks flee. Move them to neighboring sectors with the highest number of other pawns. In case of a tie (V->W->G) or no neighbors, they desert from the board (-1 pt to General).
event.36.title: Jakub's Gravity
event.36.description: Every pawn at distance 3 or greater from Jakub is pulled 1 sector closer to him.
event.37.title: Crimson Convergence
event.37.description: All Vampires on the board migrate directly to the sector where Jakub is located.
event.38.title: Alpha's Call
event.38.description: Lonesome Werewolves are pulled 1 sector closer to the largest Werewolf pack.
event.39.title: Lunar Alignment
event.39.description: Lonesome Werewolves are pulled 1 sector closer to the nearest Werewolf pack.
event.40.title: Vampire Bite
event.40.description: In any sector with at least one Vampire and one Bardak, the Vampire bites the Bardak, transforming him. If any transformation occurs, Jakub's anger towards Bardaks falls to 0.
event.41.title: Pack Infection (Rows)
event.41.description: Finds the row with the most Werewolves and at least 1 Bardak. Werewolves infect up to as many Bardaks as their count; remaining Bardaks flee to Jakub. Werewolves are redistributed. If no match, Jakub's anger towards Werewolves drops to 0, and on Bardaks increases by 5.
event.42.title: Pack Infection (Columns)
event.42.description: Finds the column with the most Werewolves and at least 1 Bardak. Werewolves infect up to as many Bardaks as their count; remaining Bardaks flee to Jakub. Werewolves are redistributed. If no match, Jakub's anger towards Werewolves drops to 0, and on Bardaks increases by 5.
event.43.title: Give Up the Ghost
event.43.description: Searches for any boundary sector occupied only by Bardaks. One of those Bardaks undergoes transformation into a Ghost. This reduces the number of Bardaks and increases Ghosts. If transformation occurs, anger towards Bardaks drops to 0, otherwise it increases by 5.
scoring_popup_werewolf_desc: Werewolf: 1 base point + 1 point for every 3 werewolves (rounding down) in target/neighbor regions. Plus 1 if Jakub is in target or neighbor.
scoring_popup_ghost_desc: Ghost: (2 - distance to edge) per pawn. -1 if in target or neighbor region (distance ≤ 1).
scoring_popup_bardak_desc: Bardak: 1 pt per pawn (0 if distance ≤ 1 from Jakub).
scoring_popup_witness_desc: Generals get +1 point for each of their pawns remaining in Jakub's region after he leaves, or after his anger towards all bands falls to 0.
scoring_popup_endgame_vampire: Vampire: 2 pts per region containing vampires.
scoring_popup_endgame_werewolf: Werewolf: 1 pt per pawn on board.
scoring_popup_endgame_ghost: Ghost: 2 pts if alone in region; 1 pt if Majority.
